about: Genobi's capability map: one entry per feature, saying where it is in the studio, which MCP tools, CLI verbs, skills and docs serve it, where it runs and on which models, and whether a dated record shows it working. Hand-maintained; npm run check:capabilities checks it against registry.json and renders docs/capabilities.md from it.

routes.local-free: Runs on this machine with no model and no spend.
routes.local-model: An open-weights model on this machine: a local ComfyUI, or a local model server for the agent.
routes.paid-api: A provider API billed per run or per token: Comfy Router, BFL, Nous, or the person's own agent subscription.
routes.comfy-cloud: Comfy Cloud, or a Comfy Developer Platform deployment, billed as Comfy GPU time.

statuses.verified: A docs page, run card or workflow README records it working on a date; evidence is that date and section.
statuses.implemented: Built and covered by tests, with no dated record of a real run yet.
statuses.planned: Specified in the docs, not built.

weights.open: The route runs the published weights, on this machine or on Comfy, so anyone can download and run them.
weights.closed: The weights are not published; the model is reached only through its provider's API.
weights.api: The route calls a provider's hosted API, so it runs no weights of ours, even where the model's weights are published elsewhere.

flux-3-klein-api.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein on BFL's API

h3-swap.name: H3 character swap LoRA with SAM 3.1

local-llm.name: An open model on a local server, such as Qwen on Ollama (Hermes)

capabilities.name: Template gallery
capabilities.where: Gallery · / (the first view), /watch/:id, /embed/:id
capabilities.description: The first view: template and generation cards, a drawer per card with drop zones, Take it to Director, and watch and embed pages.

capabilities.name: Product video, Character piece and Audio-visual
capabilities.where: Gallery · Character piece and Audio-visual drawers, then /director; Product video at /director?example=product-video (no longer a gallery card)
capabilities.description: Three house-style agent templates: the agent plans, budgets and quotes each shot, hands the takes in and finishes with a provenance card.

capabilities.name: Anime teaser and Sheet to shot
capabilities.where: Gallery · Sheet to shot drawer; Anime teaser at /director?example=anime-teaser (no longer a gallery card: the Dimensions mix is the anime teaser)
capabilities.description: A track, a character sheet and a storyboard (each dropped or generated) become two MiniMax H3 shots cut to the beat; Sheet to shot makes one shot in place.

capabilities.name: Falling room
capabilities.where: Director · /director?example=falling-room (no longer a gallery card)
capabilities.description: The free half of the generated loop: brief, World Builder take, room sound, a manual edit the agent keeps, and the editable bundle.

capabilities.name: Falling room still
capabilities.where: Director · /director?example=falling-room, the Still shot
capabilities.description: The template's one paid step: a FLUX 3 Image Klein still from the brief, with the take's first frame as its reference; not yet run.

capabilities.name: Dimensions mix
capabilities.where: Gallery · second card, /director?example=dimensions-mix
capabilities.description: A finished 23-second teaser cut from three bundled clips to a 140 BPM track with Signal overlays; nothing to generate, opens as editable lanes.

capabilities.name: Genobi teaser
capabilities.where: Gallery · /director?example=genobi-teaser
capabilities.description: A two-minute mix of the studio in use cut to a 135 BPM track: 4K studio footage with camera moves, Transitions.dev titles, Paper Shaders and a taste-layer credit; nothing to generate, opens as editable lanes.

capabilities.name: Genobi teaser run kit
capabilities.where: Agents · the genobi-teaser-run skill and scripts/verify-teaser-run.mjs
capabilities.description: An agent on a weaker open model recreates the Genobi teaser cut from its brief and repeats it from its own memory, checked by a verifier; nothing is generated.

capabilities.name: LTX-2.5 on Comfy Router, in LTX's camera words
capabilities.where: Camera · /?workspace=camera, Model menu (LTX) and Camera controls
capabilities.description: Text to video on LTX-2.5 Fast or Pro through one Comfy key; the camera panel writes shot, angle and movement in the LTX prompt guide's wording.

capabilities.name: FLUX 3 text to video, image and edit on Router
capabilities.where: Camera · Model menu (FLUX), Image and Edit modes
capabilities.description: The premium layer on Comfy Router: FLUX 3 text to video, and FLUX 3 image and edit, each quoted before it runs.

capabilities.name: FLUX 3 image to video and video upscale
capabilities.where: Camera · FLUX 3 · Image to video, and Upscale
capabilities.description: FLUX 3 from one to ten keyframes on BFL directly, and the FLUX video upscaler; no dated run in a section of its own.

capabilities.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein stills and box edits
capabilities.where: Camera · Image and Edit modes, FLUX 3 Image Klein
capabilities.description: Open-weights stills from Comfy's Klein template, with boxes written into the prompt as layout rows; also on BFL's Klein API.

capabilities.name: SeedVR2 open video upscale
capabilities.where: Camera · Upscale, SeedVR2 · Video upscale; the Dimensions mix's optional last step
capabilities.description: Comfy's core-node SeedVR2 3B template as an open workflow: the clip in, 1.5× to 3× out, free on a local ComfyUI.

capabilities.name: Upscale long clips in parts
capabilities.where: Camera · Upscale, Split into parts on a clip past 20 s (local studio); a studio agent's set is one approval
capabilities.description: A clip longer than one upscale takes, cut on frame boundaries into 19 s parts plus the remainder (a local GPU's SeedVR2 part length up to 120 s), each part its own reserved upscale under one quote and one confirmation or approval, then joined at the source's frame count with its own sound.

capabilities.name: LTX-2.5 open workflow and Acoustic Space
capabilities.where: Camera · Model menu, LTX-2.5 · Open workflow and LTX-2.5 · Acoustic Space
capabilities.description: Comfy's LTX-2.5 graph as an open workflow, and the same graph with the AKUSPACE LoRA so the sound carries the room.

capabilities.name: MiniMax H3 reference to video and Music 3
capabilities.where: Camera · Model menu (H3)
capabilities.description: H3 from two reference images on Router, or with an RGB, Canny or depth guide video on Comfy Cloud; Music 3 makes a track from a caption.

capabilities.name: Run location and workflow swap
capabilities.where: Camera · run location (Studio setup, or the model menu's Local tick; tags under the model say where a run goes); agents per session
capabilities.description: Choose local ComfyUI or Comfy Cloud for every open workflow, and swap the graph behind a model for the session.

capabilities.name: Machine check
capabilities.where: Setup · machine check; agents any time
capabilities.description: Probes memory, disk and GPU and says which models run on this machine and which on Comfy Cloud.

capabilities.name: Arena
capabilities.where: Project Tools · Arena
capabilities.description: Compare two to four models or workflows on one prompt and reference set, play them together and record the preferred one and why.

capabilities.name: Director projects edited by agents
capabilities.where: Director · /director, JSON editor and agent tools (link code)
capabilities.description: An agent links the open project by its code, reads it, applies revision-checked commands the person sees live, hands takes in and reads the person's edits back.

capabilities.name: Editable project bundle
capabilities.where: Director · Download bundle, Open bundle
capabilities.description: Download bundle writes the project, its media, the brief, feedback and the World Builder recipe as a ZIP; Open bundle checks it and reads it back for editing.

capabilities.name: Motion effects and MP4 export
capabilities.where: Director · effects and Render MP4
capabilities.description: Registered motion-effect recipes (shake, transitions, grade, speed lines, titles) and a rendered MP4 of the composition.

capabilities.name: Editor timeline
capabilities.where: Editor · /director?workspace=editor
capabilities.description: Program beside the global prompt, a frame-accurate transport, channel lanes, storyboard cells with camera and action views, and Regenerate (or Send to Genobi from the Global prompt or a clip's inspector) to the agent.

capabilities.name: Audio analysis and the beat grid
capabilities.where: Director · track lane and Timing; agents
capabilities.description: Tempo, a fitted beat grid, downbeat, onsets per band, intensity and key moments of a track, on the local server.

capabilities.name: World Builder sets and capture
capabilities.where: 3D · /world-builder and the 3D workspace
capabilities.description: Build or edit a set from presets and primitives, frame a camera move, and capture colour, depth and sound as guidance for a video model.

capabilities.name: World Builder recipes from agents
capabilities.where: 3D · World Builder on a linked project
capabilities.description: An agent sends a scene recipe or a named take to the open World Builder, which applies it and reports back.

capabilities.name: Live World sessions
capabilities.where: 3D · World, Walk mode
capabilities.description: Walk a character, trigger its moves and steer the camera; an agent pairs with a one-use code and sends bounded controls.

capabilities.name: World takes into the project from agents
capabilities.where: 3D · World Builder's Takes library, paired with an agent
capabilities.description: A paired agent reads the current recipe, loads any move-library preset by file name and sends a named take to the open project as the card's Send to Director does: first frame and MP4, labelled with the take's name.

capabilities.name: Scenes as data and room acoustics
capabilities.where: 3D · Load and Save scene, acoustics readout
capabilities.description: Agent-built primitive scenes with materials, loaded in the 3D tab, and a room's RT60 mapped to an AKUSPACE preset.

capabilities.name: 3D camera plates and playblast
capabilities.where: 3D · camera plates
capabilities.description: Ten camera plates from Holodeck's moves with curves, combo layers, gestures and a radar, played back into the Director.

capabilities.name: World Builder nodes in ComfyUI
capabilities.where: Comfy · the director_world_builder pack in a local ComfyUI
capabilities.description: Capture, Acoustics, Storyboard and Reverb nodes: a take's frames, depth and canny, the room's AKUSPACE caption and a reverb from its geometry.

capabilities.name: Dual Swords frame editor
capabilities.where: Dual Swords · the Dual Swords workspace
capabilities.description: Two clips side by side or stacked, exact frame selection, live trim preview and native or lossless export, in the browser.

capabilities.name: Media tools for agents: probe and trim
capabilities.where: Dual Swords · agents through MCP or genobi swords
capabilities.description: Check ffmpeg, probe a clip and trim a section on the studio's local ffmpeg.

capabilities.name: Media tools for agents: frames, join and crossfade
capabilities.where: Dual Swords · agents through MCP or genobi swords
capabilities.description: Pull still frames, join clips end to end and crossfade two clips on the studio's local ffmpeg.

capabilities.name: Space: an AKUSPACE room on existing sound
capabilities.where: Dual Swords · Space; agents
capabilities.description: Timed segments of a clip's own sound put through a room's impulse response by local ffmpeg convolution.

capabilities.name: Scrolls: character sheets and storyboards
capabilities.where: Scrolls · /scrolls
capabilities.description: A portable sheet or storyboard timed to a song before any video exists, with quoted image requests per sheet or panel.

capabilities.name: Setup: keys, sign-in and starting the agent
capabilities.where: Setup · first run
capabilities.description: First-run setup: Comfy and BFL keys, harness sign-in checks for Claude Code, Hermes and Codex, then the agent starts from the summary.

capabilities.name: Voice mode
capabilities.where: Studio · header microphone
capabilities.description: Speak a prompt or a brief from the header; a local model transcribes it and it goes to the prompt or the running agent.

capabilities.name: Agent sessions in the bubble and deck
capabilities.where: Studio · Genobi bubble and footer deck
capabilities.description: The studio starts the person's own agent with the Genobi tools and its own browser; the bubble shows updates and the deck the log. Hermes has its own entry.

capabilities.name: Quote, approve, then spend
capabilities.where: Studio · bubble approval; CLI submit --confirm
capabilities.description: An agent's paid step appears with its plan and price; Approve runs it once under its idempotency key, Decline voids it, nothing is retried.

capabilities.name: Hermes on an open model through Nous
capabilities.where: Agents · Hermes profile, chosen in setup
capabilities.description: Hermes held to open models with no fallback; on 28 October it ran DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Nous in one recorded studio session.

capabilities.name: Hermes on a local model server
capabilities.where: Agents · Hermes profile with a local provider
capabilities.description: Hermes on an open model served on this machine, such as Qwen on Ollama; pinned like every route, not yet run.

capabilities.name: Development: build the studio with an agent
capabilities.where: Project Tools · Development
capabilities.description: Launch Hermes Developer, Claude Code or Codex in a terminal per role, watched by a read-only supervisor viewer.

capabilities.name: Genobi starts a Developer
capabilities.where: Agents · genobi_develop; followed in Project Tools · Development
capabilities.description: A creative Genobi session hands a change to the studio itself to a Developer: the person's saved runner, in a worktree from origin/main, leaving a diff or a pull request.

capabilities.name: Genobi CLI commands
capabilities.where: Agents · the genobi command (plugins/genobi/server/genobi-cli.mjs)
capabilities.description: Every MCP tool as a terminal command with its exact schema; on 29 October an agent linked a project and sent a World Builder take through it.

capabilities.name: Genobi CLI discovery and profiles
capabilities.where: Agents · the genobi command, offline
capabilities.description: The command catalogue and exact schemas offline, private connection and model profiles, and this map with genobi capabilities.

capabilities.name: Takes from a terminal or an agent in the gallery
capabilities.where: Gallery · cards marked From terminal or From agent, on the local server
capabilities.description: A take the genobi command or an MCP client quoted and submitted shows in the studio's gallery once Ready, marked with where it came from; the studio plays it, recreates it and sends it to the Director's assets.

capabilities.name: Skills and wiki search for agents
capabilities.where: Agents · MCP and CLI
capabilities.description: An agent lists and loads skills and searches and reads the wiki.

capabilities.name: Registry search and this capability map
capabilities.where: Agents · MCP and CLI
capabilities.description: Search tools and skills by tag or text, and read this capability map before choosing a route.

capabilities.name: Taste layer, project memory and licences
capabilities.where: Studio · /taste; agents per project
capabilities.description: Curated creative libraries and scoped preferences, project decisions and checkpoints shared across harnesses, and a licence report per result.

capabilities.name: Openjutsu character swap with a Klein first frame
capabilities.where: Comfy · npm run swap or an agent's quote (local studio only)
capabilities.description: Swap the person in a 5 to 15 second part of a clip; Genobi makes the first frame with a Klein box edit, so a box can change a whole person or one item.

capabilities.name: AKUSPACE ComfyUI in Docker
capabilities.where: Comfy · a rented GPU box or a local Docker host
capabilities.description: A pinned ComfyUI image with the AKUSPACE nodes and ComfyUI-LTXVideo whose verify command checks every graph; built and checked on CPU, no render has run.

capabilities.name: Hosted studio on Cloudflare Pages
capabilities.where: Hosted · Cloudflare Pages
capabilities.description: The earlier hosted FLUX studio on Pages, with D1, R2 and the visitor's own BFL key; its library runs are recorded without a dated section, and this release is not deployed.

capabilities.name: Layout-to-Render from a World Builder take
capabilities.where: 3D · capture, then a Comfy workflow
capabilities.description: A Three.js playblast drives LTX-2.5 with the Layout-to-Render IC-LoRA from an art-directed first frame; no registered run yet.

capabilities.name: Gen-Mod: edit frame 0, carry it through
capabilities.where: Director · a take's frame 0
capabilities.description: An edited first frame and the source soundtrack or pose drive a new LTX-2.5 take; the graphs are built, not registered or run.

capabilities.name: Desktop app
capabilities.where: Studio · a desktop shell
capabilities.description: The studio as a Tauri desktop app with its data folder in the app data directory.
